## 2026-08-29 - Adding Accessible Labels for Compact Layouts
**Learning:** Using `sr-only` classes for labels on inputs allows for screen reader accessibility without breaking compact, horizontally-aligned UI layouts (like a header search/link bar). Furthermore, using React's `useId()` hook ensures proper linking via `id` and `htmlFor` without risking collisions across multiple component instances.
**Action:** When adding labels to existing components where a visual label would clutter the design, apply a `sr-only` class and link it to the input using a stable ID generated by `useId()`. Always provide `aria-label` for icon-only action buttons.
